plugins.description: Social intelligence for Claude. Read posts, spoken transcripts, comments, creators, trending sounds and hashtags across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Bilibili — then act on what you learn: write hooks, create variants to film, score a draft before you publish, and repurpose a post for other surfaces. 24 tools, OAuth 2.1, billed in orchyn credits (20 free to start).
